an3.130:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami. Upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi
an3.130:1.2: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Anuruddho āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca:
an3.130:1.3: Idhāhaṃ āvuso Sāriputta dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemi.
an3.130:1.4: Āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ.
an3.130:1.5: Atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatī ti. 2.
an3.130:2.1: Yaṃ kho te āvuso Anuruddha evaṃ hoti --
an3.130:2.2: ahaṃ dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena sahassaṃ lokaṃ olokemī ti, idan te mānasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.3: Yam pi te āvuso Anuruddha evam hoti --
an3.130:2.4: āraddhaṃ kho pana me viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati asammuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggan ti, idan te uddhaccasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.5: Yam pi te āvuso Anuruddha evam hoti --
an3.130:2.6: atha ca pana me na anupādāya āsavehi cittaṃ vimuccatī ti, idan te kukkuccasmiṃ.
an3.130:2.7: Sādhu vat' āyasmā Anuruddho ime tayo dhamme pahāya ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃharatū ti. 3.
an3.130:3.1: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho aparena samayena ime tayo dhamme pahāya ime tayo dhamme amanasikaritvā amatāya dhātuyā cittaṃ upasaṃhāsi.
an3.130:3.2: Atha kho āyasmā Anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirass' eva yass' atthāya kulaputtā sammad eva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tad anuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi,
an3.130:3.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyā ti abbhaññāsi.
an3.130:3.4: Aññataro ca pan' āyasmā Anuruddho arahataṃ ahosī ti. 129. 1.
